reason: I already tried Motion and Sunsama and cancelled a $20 planner last quarter; every time, I drift back to blocking straight in Google Calendar with a plain task list. The 'done, push, shrink or drop' prompt is basically Sunsama's shutdown ritual, and the notes, contacts and email bundle is more than I want to move into.
objection: I've tried Motion and Sunsama, so why would this one stick? Planners die for me when I stop opening a second app, and this asks me to move even more of my life into it.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked as a thin layer on top of my actual Google Calendar, with blocks written straight to GCal and the end-of-block prompt arriving where I already am, I'd try the free plan and maybe pay after the trial.
